newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Deutsche sees Russia Eurobond end of next week.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche sees Russia Eurobond end of next week.

text.p: A board member of Deutsche Bank AG said on Friday that he expected Russia to issue a eurobond worth between 1.5 and two billion marks by the end of next week.
Deutsche Bank management board emmber Georg Krupp told a Moscow news conference there would be a roadshow to introduce the bond in Frankfurt and in Zurich at the start of next week.
"We assume that we can go to market with the bond at the end of next week," Krupp said. Deutsche is co-lead manager of the bond with CS-First Boston.

Krupp noted that Russia and its advisers had earlier been talking in terms of a 1.5 billion mark eurobond. "The way market conditions are now, we can issue a bond of up to 2 billion marks," he said. --Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
